digest.component_or_area: snapshot-entry contract and schemas drift gate
propositions: Snapshot-entry contract is defined in an orphaned hand-rolled Python module (_snapshot_schema.py) that is imported by no production code, so changes to fetcher.py output diverge from the declared schema without detection.
The snapshot schema encodes a parent present-vs-absent distinction that gates a data-destroying inbound CLEAR operation, but lacks machine-enforced validation.

90 sibling schemas in src/rebar/schemas/ are validated automatically via jsonschema and Draft202012Validator under a CI drift gate (gen_types), while the snapshot contract is manually maintained outside that machinery.

Real fetcher output fixtures exist (bridge_state/snapshots/, 548 files) covering all snapshot shapes (populated, parent-absent, horizon-trimmed-empty) but contain PII and are gitignored, so a redacted test fixture must be created.

Moving the snapshot-entry contract into src/rebar/schemas/ and wiring it through schemas.load() and the generated-types drift gate will make fetcher output changes fail CI if they diverge from the schema.
